Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
The Lost kindred cards introduced Environmental damage, but Vengeful Spirit "inflicts" damage as a retainer, not Environmental.

> Name: Vengeful Spirit
> Cardtype: Retainer
> Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
> Cost: 1 blood
> Wraith with 2 life.
> The employer gets +1 bleed. Vengeful Spirit inflicts 1 damage on the opposing minion each round of combat during normal strike resolution at close range.
> Artist: Ginés Quiñonero
>
Wolf Companion has the following text:

> Name: Wolf Companion
> [Jyhad:U2, VTES:U, Sabbat:U, SW:PT, KMW:PG, Third:PTz2]
> Cardtype: Retainer
> Cost: 1 blood
> Discipline: Animalism
> Animal with 2 life.
> [ani] When the minion with this retainer is in combat, the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution (if the range is close).
> [ANI] As above, but Wolf Companion has 3 life.
> Artist: Zina Saunders; Melissa Benson
>
Emphasis mine.

What is the source of damage on Wolf Companion? Is it Wolf Companion (inflicts) or Environmental?

I'm trying to figure out what are the niche scenarios where Environmental and retainer damage have different interactions. Neither are inflicted by the opposing minion (Disarm, Pulled Fangs), and there are as of yet no cards that would, for example, prevent damage from Environmental only.

Where does the wording matter, and why isn't Vengeful Spirit Environmental damage?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Kraus wrote:
> What is the source of damage on Wolf Companion? Is it Wolf Companion (inflicts) or Environmental?
>
Anything not from a minion is environmental.

www.vekn.net/general-rulings
Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if the damage is from a strike or if an effect specifically states that the damage is dealt by the minion. Damage from other effects is considered "environmental," and has no particular source. [RTR 19970630]

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> jamesatzephyr wrote:
>
> > Kraus wrote:
> > What is the source of damage on Wolf Companion? Is it Wolf Companion (inflicts) or Environmental?
> >
> Anything not from a minion is environmental.
>
> www.vekn.net/general-rulings
> Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if the damage is from a strike or if an effect specifically states that the damage is dealt by the minion. Damage from other effects is considered "environmental," and has no particular source. [RTR 19970630]
>
This has changed (implicitely through card text). The damage inflicted by Vengeful Spirit is inflicted by the retainer: this means that a vampire who is immune to damage dealt by wraiths, or retainers, would take no damage from the Vengeful Spirit. (Wolf Companion will be changed accordingly).
Damage from minions hasn't changed.
Environmental damage is now reserved to effects that have no specific source (Carrion Crows).

I've edited the General Ruling section.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Body:
> drnlmza wrote:
> There are other cards that reference damage from retainers - for example: Eyes of Blade or Carolina Vález
> ...
> Clarifying exactly which effects apply for these cases seems sensible.

Environmental damage generated by a retainer card could easily be distinguished from environmental damage generated by a combat card (Carrion Crows), a master card (Spawning Pool), while still both being environmental.

As I say, Ankha is entitled to make any ruling he wants. However, I would prefer rulings were made from a position of understanding what the ruling actually achieved, rather than knee-jerk re-writing of card text based on facts which aren't true.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> jamesatzephyr wrote:
>
> > drnlmza wrote:
> > There are other cards that reference damage from retainers - for example: Eyes of Blade or Carolina Vález
> > ...
> > Clarifying exactly which effects apply for these cases seems sensible.
> >
> Environmental damage generated by a retainer card could easily be distinguished from environmental damage generated by a combat card (Carrion Crows), a master card (Spawning Pool), while still both being environmental.
>
They could be distinguished, but using the same word for two different things is not what I am aiming at. I find it clearer to distinguish explicitly damage that have no source ("environmental") from damage that come from a source, including a retainer.
That's why all damage-dealing retainers (such as Wolf Companion "When the minion with this retainer is in combat, the opposing minion takes 1 damage...") has been changed to indicate the damage come from the retainer explicitely.

> jamesatzephyr wrote:
> As I say, Ankha is entitled to make any ruling he wants. However, I would prefer rulings were made from a position of understanding what the ruling actually achieved, rather than knee-jerk re-writing of card text based on facts which aren't true.
